ConnectionStrings._comment: Live production DB — same connection as the API. UPDATE if running against a different env.

Brevo._comment: Same Brevo API key the live API uses (Sendinblue). Replace if rotated.

ZonalAwards._comment: Hard gate for the --zonal-awards mode. Even if invoked, this stays paused until set to true. Prevents accidental overwrites of migrated Auto values before they're verified.

Brand._comment: ROW instance brand (Services/Brand.cs). Deployment values; set per server, e.g. Brand__PortalDomain.
